steps.en: Install the wheel, which bundles SDL on common platforms
steps.zh: 装 wheel 包，常见平台上 SDL 已经打包在里面

steps.en: Open a window and load your images, sounds and fonts
steps.zh: 开一个窗口，加载图片、声音和字体

steps.en: Write the game loop: read events, update positions, blit, flip, tick
steps.zh: 写游戏循环：读事件、改位置、贴图、刷新、限帧

steps.en: Collects keyboard, mouse and window events from the OS into a queue via SDL
steps.zh: 通过 SDL 把键盘、鼠标、窗口事件收进一个队列

steps.en: Copies your surfaces into the window and shows the finished frame on flip
steps.zh: 把你的图层拷进窗口，flip 时显示出完整的一帧

steps.en: Paces the loop to your frame rate while the mixer plays sound alongside
steps.zh: 把循环卡在你定的帧率上，同时由混音器放声音

value.en: A playable window with input and sound from plain Python — no engine or editor to learn
value.zh: 用纯 Python 就有了能玩的窗口、输入和声音，不用学引擎或编辑器

sources: https://github.com/pygame/pygame/blob/main/examples/chimp.py (display.set_mode, image loading, event.get(), blit, display.flip(), clock.tick(60), sprite groups)
https://www.pygame.org/docs/ (display, image, event, mixer, time.Clock reference)
